course.title: Regional Development Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A tube well taps an artesian aquifer. Find its yield in litres per hour for a drawdown of (11) 3 m when the diameter of the well is 20 cm and the thickness of the aquifer is 30 m. Assume the co-efficient of permeability to be 35 m/day. If the diameter of the well is doubled find the percentage increase in the yield, the other condition remains same. Assume the radius of influence as 300 m in both cases.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2014
